name: hypes
description: Adapt explanations using only narrowly evidenced understanding clues.

interface.shortDescription: Clear, natural responses for what matters now
interface.longDescription: Hypes adapts explanations from the visible conversation and retains a narrow clue only after a direct save request, correction, demonstrated application, confirmed explanation outcome, or repetition across conversations. A completed request or an explanation written by the assistant is not evidence. Hypes keeps no raw conversation and makes no general judgment about the user's skill or personality. Its private data remains on this Mac across plugin updates.
defaultPrompt: Explain this using what I have already shown I understand.
Explain this without repeating a distinction I have already applied.
Show what Hypes currently retains about this concept.
